purpose: Teach: 割高/協業/行程/必勝/品切れ/伝言/月給/当座

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外仕入れが割高なので国内に切り替えましょう
lines.en: Let's switch to domestic suppliers since overseas sourcing is getting too expensive.
lines.style: Clear, decisive opening. Brisk pace, no hesitation. Voice sits firmly on the proposal. Professional but not cold — this is problem-solving, not decree.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。協業先との打ち合わせを設定しました
lines.en: Done. I've set up the meeting with our partner company.
lines.style: Prompt, efficient confirmation. Slight lift of satisfaction — the task is already complete. Respectful but easy tone. No strain.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトの行程表を更新しましょう
lines.style: Clear directive, calm authority. Measured pace. Voice carries forward momentum without rushing. The tone of someone moving through a checklist with focus.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コンペには必勝の気概で臨みます
lines.en: Done. I'm going into this competition with full determination to win.
lines.style: Firm commitment underlying the words. Slight reinforcement on 「win」—not boastful, just resolute. Eyes forward. Steady breathing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 注目商品の品切れを防ぎましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we don't run out of stock on our featured products.
lines.style: Direct instruction, businesslike. Even pace. Voice carries a practical edge—this is risk management. No drama, just prevention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様への伝言メモを残しました
lines.en: Done. I've left a message with our regular clients.
lines.style: Brisk, factual completion. Slight nod in the voice—the groundwork is covered. Efficient without being rushed. Small tone of satisfaction.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員の月給見直し案を検討しましょう
lines.en: Let's review the proposal for adjusting staff salaries.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful opening. Slightly softer than the previous directives—this topic carries weight. Voice sits level, inviting consideration rather than commanding it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当座の運転資金を確保しております
lines.en: Done. I've secured the operating capital we need for now.
lines.style: Steady close. Quiet confidence underneath. Voice carries assurance without fanfare. The final word lands with finality—all bases covered. Professional exhale.
